ActiveAI Security What is ActiveAI Security? Proactive. Intelligent. Dynamic. ActiveAI Security is our philosophy for the role we believe AI must play to successfully mitigate cyber risk. It embodies an intelligent, dynamic use of AI, that adapts to the environment, the threat landscape and your business. It allows defenders to remain ahead of their adversaries. Gain complete visibility over your attack paths to eliminate security gaps and mitigate risk Intelligently correlate threats across your entire organization with a deep contextual understanding of your business operations Transform SecOps with automated investigation of every relevant alert, including third-party, combined with real-time autonomous response Correlation of threats across your entire organization with a deep contextual understanding of your business operations Complete visibility over your attack paths to eliminate security gaps and mitigate risk Continual automated investigation of every alert, combined with real-time autonomous response Better security outcomes. The flexible Darktrace ActiveAI Security Platform can help you achieve comprehensive protection across part or all of your organization, from communications to cloud and everything between. Powered by our unique AI Rather than teaching an AI system what an ‘attack’ looks like, training it on large data lakes of thousands of organizations’ data, Self-Learning AI learns from your unique business data to understand what is normal to identify high-risk, anomalous activity for each asset across domains. Through this approach, Darktrace provides the ability to visualize and correlate security incidents uninhibited by the siloed approach of individual point solutions.
